t: Undercover Asia: Black Markets and Slave Trades
d: Thousands of vulnerable migrants have been enslaved onboard untraceable Thai fishing boats. What can be done?
Meet the latest ladies on the line-up, and the detention officers who try to keep them in line.
The women are forced spend the majority of the Thanksgiving break trapped in their tiny cells.

st: Jack the Ripper: The Invention of the Serial Killer (1888)
d: In 1888, a series of gruesome murders shocked London: The perpetrator was dubbed “Jack the Ripper”.
In 1929, seven members of Bugs Moran's gang are assassinated in a garage by Al Capone's henchmen.
Serial killer and necrophile Dennis Nilsen murdered at least twelve males between 1978 and 1983 around London.
Go inside the twisted, savage mind of Rosemary West, who, with her husband, tortured and murdered nine women.
